root_cause.text: The error path in `rockchip_usb2phy_probe()` after successfully breaking from `for_each_available_child_of_node()` (which already releases `child_np` via `of_node_put()`) jumps to the `put_child` label and calls `of_node_put()` a second time, causing a double-free of the device node reference.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: “for_each_available_child_of_node() calls of_node_put() to release child_np in each success loop. After breaking from the loop with the child_np has been released, the code will jump to the put_child label and will call the of_node_put() again if the devm_request_threaded_irq() fails.” The patch replaces `goto put_child;` with `return ret;` to avoid the duplicate `of_node_put()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix error handling in rockchip_usb2phy_probe by returning directly instead of going to cleanup label, avoiding potential double-free or unnecessary cleanup.
intent_record.what: In the error handling block after a failed devm_request_irq, changed `goto put_child;` to `return ret;`.
intent_record.how: When the IRQ request fails, the function now returns immediately with the error code instead of jumping to the `put_child` label for cleanup. This avoids executing any cleanup code that might be redundant or harmful.
